verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents an OpenAI-compatible REST API (plus Anthropic Messages API and Open Responses API) that can be driven by any standard SDK/client, well-documented for programmatic/agentic use. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe attempts to fetch openapi.json/swagger.json all 404) and no llms.txt, so full API introspection tooling is absent.
